data.content_ref: inline:The 'Variance Floor' claim (00321f6b) integrates with the 'Algorithmic Floor' claim (051b3183) by providing the social oversight mechanism (panel collective) that prevents the 'blind obedience' failure mode of the deterministic process; this relation is refuted if the panel's collective verification does not statistically reduce the probability of algorithmic execution errors compared to a single non-expert.
